parsed.basis: Plateaux is a sparsely populated interior department centred on Djambala, with limited tourist infrastructure and no separate legal regime for transgender visitors. The Republic of the Congo does not criminalise consensual same-sex conduct between adults, though an unequal age-of-consent provision has been invoked by police to solicit bribes and no legal gender recognition or protection against gender-identity discrimination or hate crime exists. Documented violence and harassment against LGBTQI+ people, largely by family members, has been punished where reported, while social attitudes remain hostile. No region-specific information distinguishes Plateaux from the national picture on enforcement, documentation practice, facilities, or recourse for a visitor who is outed.
